name: George Louthan
biography: is a Masters student at the University of Tulsa. His research interests include network security and monitoring, enterprise security management, and lately security engineering. He has spoken recently about the role of signature-based network protocol identification in modern networks and contributed to the development of a protocol identification system nicknamed SAND.
